qs.q: While studying spinal embryology, a student reviews the origin of different parts of the intervertebral disc. What is the embryonic origin of the nucleus pulposus?
qs.e: The nucleus pulposus originates from the notochord, whereas the annulus fibrosus originates from the sclerotome. The neural crest forms peripheral nervous tissue.
qs.s: PAT 3 Marathon — Lower Limb, Upper Limb, Spine & Histology (20 Nov 2015) — Study

qs.q: The embryonic milk line normally obliterates except in the chest region where the mammary gland develops. What is the clinical consequence of the abnormal persistence of parts of this line?
qs.e: The abnormal persistence of the embryonic milk line leads to polythelia, characterized by supernumerary nipples. Gynecomastia refers to glandular proliferation in males rather than persistence of the ridge.
qs.s: Week 12 Review — Skin, Embryology, Spine & Skull — Study Notes: MCQs

qs.q: Which long association fiber runs within the cingulate gyrus and connects parts of the limbic system to handle emotional processing and memory?
qs.e: The cingulum runs within the cingulate gyrus to connect parts of the limbic system for emotional processing and memory. The uncinate fasciculus connects the frontal and temporal lobes but does not specifically run within the cingulate gyrus.
qs.s: White Matter Fibres of the Brain — Study Notes: MCQs

qs.q: What embryological process causes the formation of fenestrations in the upper part of the growing septum primum?
qs.e: The upper part of the septum primum undergoes apoptosis to develop fenestrations that coalesce into the ostium secundum. Necrosis is pathological cell death rather than programmed development.
qs.s: Development of the Interatrial Septum — Study Notes: MCQs

qs.q: Which derivative of the primitive heart tube forms the smooth part of the right atrium known as the sinus venarum?
qs.e: The sinus venosus develops into the smooth part of the right atrium (sinus venarum) and the coronary sinus. The primitive atrium forms the rough, trabeculated parts of the atria instead.
qs.s: Development of the Heart — Study Notes: MCQs

qs.q: Which activity is part of building effective search strategies when using search engines and directories?
o: Using keywords, operators, field searching and domain searching
Installing secure firewall extensions on the web browser software
Manually typing every internet Protocol address into the URL bar
Formatting reference citations according to academic journal rules
qs.e: Effective search strategies involve keywords, operators, field searching, and domain searching to locate information quickly. Firewall installation and manual IP typing are unrelated to search strategy formulation.
qs.s: HIT100: Information Technology — Course Syllabus — Study Notes: MCQs

qs.q: Which tool should be used to quickly copy existing character or paragraph formatting to another part of the document?
qs.e: Format Painter copies formatting from one selection and applies it to another. The Thesaurus is used solely to find synonyms.
qs.s: MS Word — HIT100 Course Notes: MCQs

qs.q: Which of the following layers is NOT part of the tri-laminar embryonic disc?
qs.e: The tri-laminar embryonic disc consists of the ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm. The periderm is a temporary outer layer of the embryonic skin, not a germ layer of the disc.

es.q: As part of a forensic investigation involving a suspected poisoning, the role of the liver in metabolism and excretion is crucial. Outline the primary functions of bile in the human body.
es.m: Bile plays two primary functions essential for bodily health: 1. **Elimination:** It facilitates the excretion of water-insoluble substances, including bilirubin, excess cholesterol, and various xenobiotics (foreign compounds) from the body. 2. **Emulsification:** In the gut, bile emulsifies dietary fats, a critical step for their digestion and absorption.
es.s: Liver Histology, Physiology and Pathology — Practice Questions — Essay Questions
